input_fail_closed_rules: The canonical run must download GitHub Actions artifact 10600470520 from workflow run 35493369936.
The downloaded ZIP SHA-256 must exactly equal the frozen TRACE-002 artifact ZIP SHA-256.
TRACE_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json SHA-256 must exactly equal the frozen manifest SHA-256.
The canonical JSONL SHA-256 and record count must exactly match TRACE-002.
No API re-query, source rematerialization, pair substitution, cursor expansion, row repair, or alternate artifact is permitted if any identity check fails.
The implementation files used by canonical execution must retain the exact frozen Git blob identities from S8E-IMPLFREEZE-001.

trace_preparation.observation_window_mapping: Each JSONL row start/end is an observation-opportunity timing proxy only.
trace_preparation.ordering: Sort each trace by absolute start then end then observation id.
trace_preparation.merge_rule: Union overlapping or directly abutting windows within each trace. Preserve source observation IDs in provenance output.
trace_preparation.time_basis: UTC absolute source timestamps converted to exact integer microseconds for ingestion, then exact Fraction seconds relative to each anchor for model evaluation.

forward_coverage_proof.source_ordering: SatNOGS release 1.134 first-page ordering is descending start then descending end.
forward_coverage_proof.implication: For any retained first-page observation in a frozen trace, omitted cursor-page observations are older. Omitted pages therefore cannot hide a later observation after a retained anchor.
forward_coverage_proof.boundary: This proves forward observation completeness only through 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z for the 20 TRACE-002 pairs. TRACE-002 is not a complete backward history and is not the full June SatNOGS population.

per_trace: inter_opportunity_gap_seconds for every adjacent merged-window pair
gap_population_standard_deviation_seconds where at least two gaps
gap_coefficient_of_variation where at least two gaps and mean > 0
gap_burstiness_index=(sd-mean)/(sd+mean) where at least two gaps and denominator > 0
timing_endpoints.median_definition: For ordered finite values, odd n uses the middle value; even n uses arithmetic mean of the two middle values.
timing_endpoints.standard_deviation_definition: Population standard deviation using divisor n, not n-1.
timing_endpoints.decimal_rendering: Non-rational square-root-derived metrics are rendered as decimal strings rounded HALF_EVEN to 12 digits after the decimal; underlying comparisons do not use rendered decimal values.

anchor_population.candidate_anchor: End time of every merged observation-opportunity window in a frozen trace.
anchor_population.eligibility: anchor_time + 24 hours <= 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z, using the forward-coverage proof defined in trace_preparation.
anchor_population.rationale: The same anchor set must have complete frozen source-window follow-up for all 6/12/24-hour comparisons.
anchor_population.future_window_rule: For each horizon, use only merged windows strictly after the anchor; clip any future window that crosses anchor+horizon.
anchor_population.zero_future_windows: Anchor remains in the finite observed anchor population; all threshold cases may be structurally non-finite.

minimum_rate_endpoint.quantity: minimum positive integer hypothetical uniform effective payload rate in bits per second required for TRUST_RESTORED strictly before the horizon

sufficient_upper_bound.formula: For a case with at least one positive-duration future window, B = sum(profile_object_bytes) + max(profile_object_bytes), d_min = shortest positive future-window duration in exact seconds, and U_strict = floor(8 * B / d_min) + 1 integer bps.
sufficient_upper_bound.rationale: U_strict is the smallest positive integer rate strictly greater than 8B/d_min. Therefore B modeled bytes require strictly less than d_min seconds. Every positive future window has duration >= d_min, so byte capacity is non-limiting strictly before the end of any such window, including exact-divisibility cases. For A2/A3, any remaining infeasibility at U_strict is due to required later-window/event ordering, which higher rate cannot create.
sufficient_upper_bound.interpretation_guard: U_strict is a model-search sufficiency construction, not a physical link capacity. A failure at U_strict is classified as no finite threshold under the frozen model only after independent bound agreement, because U_strict makes the complete nominal bundle plus one largest-object retransmission finish strictly within every positive-duration future window.

minimum_rate_endpoint.threshold_search: Monotone integer binary search from 1 through the sufficient upper bound, inclusive.
postconditions: A finite threshold T must succeed at T.
The primary and independently reimplemented strict sufficient upper bounds must match exactly.
If U_strict fails, classify the case as no finite threshold under the frozen model.

p3_vs_p1.threshold_difference: P3 minimum_rate_bps - P1 minimum_rate_bps when both are finite
p3_vs_p1.common_rate_state_cost_secondary: Where both thresholds are finite, evaluate P1 and P3 at max(P1_threshold,P3_threshold) and report exact matched differences in predecessor exposure, control unavailability, windows consumed, bytes transferred, and transition attempts.

profile_burden_ordering.nonfinite_semantics: Treat no-finite-threshold as +infinity for ordering only.
profile_burden_ordering.endpoint: Count exact violations of nondecreasing minimum-rate burden across the ordered profiles.

permitted: Compare whether P3 and P1 remain equal in terminal finite-rate feasibility.
Compare whether higher standardized object burden remains non-improving in matched extension conditions.
Compare external-trace failure/feasibility patterns descriptively with the frozen Study 8 logical-contact findings.
not_identifiable: The controlled equal-total-capacity R1-R4 Study 8 contrast is not re-estimated because TRACE-002 traces are not equalized for total physical opportunity duration or capacity.
No causal claim that observed external timing alone caused between-trace threshold differences.

statistics.population_type: complete finite frozen Study 8E trace/anchor/case population defined by this protocol
statistics.null_handling: No-finite-threshold is a substantive endpoint category, not missing data.

exact_comparison_scope: threshold-achieving terminal state and state-cost fields
independent_audit.acceptance: zero mismatches across every canonical case
independent_audit.repeatability: Run the primary canonical execution twice from the same verified TRACE-002 artifact; deterministic scientific output hashes must match exactly.

canonical_output_rules.row_ordering: Deterministic lexicographic ordering by trace selection order, anchor chronological index, horizon, profile order, policy order, disruption order.

execution_fail_closed_rules: Any frozen input hash mismatch stops execution.
Any case-level primary/reference mismatch stops result freeze.
Any duplicate anchor_id or duplicate case key stops execution.
Any threshold postcondition failure stops execution.
Any unexpected stale_epoch_acceptance=1 or rollback_invoked=1 is retained and flagged, not silently repaired.
No TRACE-002 row, trace, anchor, factor, or result may be dropped after endpoint inspection.
No implementation change is permitted during canonical execution; a required change invalidates the run and requires a new implementation freeze.

claim_boundary.valid_description: Results apply to the frozen 20-pair, 476-record TRACE-002 first-page projection under the frozen Study 8E transition model and hypothetical uniform effective payload-rate abstraction.
